title: Minton's and marijuana among musicians
summary: He did not like Minton's because of the junkies, and says musicians kept marijuana away from him.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Did you go over to Minton's quite often when you were living here?
You didn't like it over there?
That's something that we didn't talk about. At the time that you were coming up and all of the time, I mean from the very beginning, did you meet - were there many musicians who smoked pot?
Were there many musicians who smoked marijuana?
If they did, I didn't know too much about it. If they did, you know, they would keep it away from me...
